mentions.name: Cekyukle
mentions.description: Turkish-language web app built for a street photographer that lets people who appear in his photos download their photos when available and give permission for them to be published. It is offered as a hosted multi-user service at cekyukle.com, with an open-source single-user version (no multi-user requirements) on GitHub.
mentions.problem: Street photographers lack an easy way to share photos with the people photographed and to obtain their permission before publishing the images.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://cekyukle.com (ie. shoot & upload in Turkish)

I built it for a street photographer friend so he could let people in his photos download their photos when available, and also get their permission to publish them. There is a version without without multi-user requirements under my GH:  https://github.com/hikmet/people-in-photos
mentions.author: crazybLanKeT
